# Matthew Cuthbert

## Overview

- **Age:** Sixty years old at the time of Anne's arrival  <sub>[v1 c2 P3](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0003)</sub>
- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v1 c2 P2](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0002), [v1 c2 P3](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0003)</sub>
- **Status:** Deceased  <sub>[v1 c37 P1](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0001), [v1 c37 P9](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0009)</sub>
- **Role:** Farmer  <sub>[v1 c1 P19](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0019)</sub>

## Appearance

Matthew was an odd-looking man with an ungainly figure and stooping shoulders. He had long iron-gray hair that touched his shoulders and had worn a full, soft brown beard since the age of twenty. At sixty, he looked much the same as he did at twenty, with a bit more grayness.

_Sources: [v1 c2 P3](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0003)_

## Personality

Extremely shy, quiet, and bashful, Matthew stood in dread of almost all women and strange girls, feeling that they secretly laughed at him. Despite his extreme shyness, he possessed a deeply kind, gentle, and sympathetic heart. He was a silent listener who felt a warm, immediate affection for Anne Shirley, often becoming her quiet advocate and champion against Marilla's strictness.

_Sources: [v1 c2 P3](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0003), [v1 c2 P12](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0012), [v1 c2 P14](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0014), [v1 c6 P20](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0020), [v1 c25 P0](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0000), [v1 c25 P4](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0004), [v1 c37 P10](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0010)_

## Goals

- Adopt a boy to help with farm work at Green Gables  <sub>[v1 c2 P7](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0007), [v1 c1 P16](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0016)</sub>

## History

Matthew Cuthbert lived at Green Gables with his sister Marilla, running their farm on the edge of Avonlea. Intending to adopt an orphan boy to assist with farm work, Matthew traveled to Bright River station, only to find an eleven-year-old orphan girl named Anne Shirley waiting instead. Despite his severe shyness around women and girls, Matthew was captivated by Anne's lively chatter on the drive home and quickly favored keeping her at Green Gables. When Marilla considered giving Anne to the harsh Mrs. Blewett, Matthew firmly opposed the idea. Over time, Matthew quietly supported Anne, noticing details others missed; he even braved a store trip to buy her a dress with fashionable puffed sleeves for Christmas. After several years of quiet devotion to Anne and his farm, Matthew suffered fatal heart failure upon reading a newspaper report detailing the unexpected collapse of the Abbey Bank.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P16](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0016), [v1 c2 P4](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0004), [v1 c2 P7](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0007), [v1 c2 P16](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0016), [v1 c2 P17](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0017), [v1 c6 P20](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0020), [v1 c6 P30](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0030), [v1 c25 P0](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0000), [v1 c25 P4](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0004), [v1 c25 P5](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0005), [v1 c37 P1](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0001), [v1 c37 P9](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0009)_

## Background by volume

- Lived at Green Gables in Avonlea for his entire life
- Had worn a beard continuously since turning twenty  <sub>[v1 c2 P3](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0003)</sub>
- Shared Green Gables with his sister Marilla  <sub>[v1 c1 P7](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0007)</sub>

## Quotes

> I’m not expecting a girl. It’s a boy I’ve come for. He should be here. Mrs. Alexander Spencer was to bring him over from Nova Scotia for me.  <sub>[v1 c2 P7](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0007)</sub>

> Well now, I dunno,  <sub>[v1 c2 P23](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0023)</sub>
